title: 1908 Keith & Plummer rebuilt after 1907 fire
description: Two entrepreneurs, Webster Keith and Amasa Plummer, joined forces in 1894 to construct an attractive two-storey building on a lot south of the present library. This building was destroyed in the fire of 1907. After the site was cleared, they rebuilt: this time, a solid brick two-storey structure with a firewall. The new building housed a millinery, a general grocery offering bulk products, grains, clothing, furniture, housewares, and linens, and operated on a barter system. There was enough space on the street level for another business, while the upper floor accommodated tenants, including a dental parlor, law office, and families. A balcony was added later.
